ns2:course.label: Research Methods and Design
ns2:course.description: Provides foundations for quantitative and qualitative research methodologies and design principles for investigating problems in social and behavioral sciences. Focuses on language of research and evaluation, purposes, validity threats, data collection methods, and critical evaluation of current literature. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: ALEC 505.
